headline: Türkiye Begins 29.3 Billion Lira Interim Payouts for Liquidated Funds
summary: Türkiye started interim payments totaling 29.3 billion Turkish Liras to over 235,000 investors across seven investment funds undergoing extraordinary liquidation following a recent scandal.
why: The liquidation of local investment funds and subsequent state-managed payouts affect domestic investor confidence and liquidity within Türkiye's capital markets.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Interim payouts return liquidity to investors locked in funds undergoing extraordinary liquidation.
